5 ready / 13 actions

Condensate: 0 / 10. Conservatory mist: +0.125 per played minute.

Open-mist absorption: Learning.

Receive ambient mist without a deliberate circulation drill. Keeps the original rate and 75% purification chance.

Outflow sluice: jammed. Clearing it drives 2 condensate of pressure; Open-mist absorption (Learning) spends 2. The keeper pays 2 coins per cleared jam.

The keeper says her grandmother cut this outflow herself after a hard winter. The sluice is hers, and she pays whoever clears it.
